Here’s how your wife can make the most of your Amazon Prime membership when shopping at Whole Foods:  

### 1. Link Prime to Whole Foods
- Download the **Amazon** or **Whole Foods Market** app.  
- Sign in with your Prime account.  
- In the app, go to **Whole Foods Market** settings and link Prime to your account.  

### 2. Get Prime Discounts in Store
- When checking out at Whole Foods, she can:  
  - **Scan the QR code** from the Whole Foods app, OR  
  - **Enter her phone number** linked to the Prime account at checkout.  
- This unlocks **Prime Member Deals** (extra discounts on sale items) and **10% off many sale prices**.  

### 3. Use Prime for Grocery Delivery or Pickup
- Through the **Amazon app** or **website**, she can order Whole Foods groceries for delivery (where available) or free pickup (on orders over a set minimum, usually around $35).  

### 4. Look for Exclusive Weekly Prime Deals
- Prime members get rotating discounts on popular items (marked with a **blue sign in store**).  
- Some products are only discounted for Prime shoppers.  

---

👉 In short:  
- Link Prime to the Whole Foods app.  
- Show QR code or use phone number at checkout.  
- Use Amazon/Whole Foods apps for delivery & pickup.  
- Take advantage of Prime-exclusive sales and 10% off.  

Would you like me to also put together a **step-by-step walk-through just for in-store shopping** (so she doesn’t need to mess with the delivery part), or should I cover both store and online in detail?
So my wife was wondering how should she go about using our prime membership at whole foods
